title: CKM_EDDSA missing CKF_VERIFY in GetMechanismInfo
description: C_GetMechanismInfo reports CKM_EDDSA flags as CKF_SIGN only. C_VerifyInit accepts CKM_EDDSA. PKCS#11 2.40 requires CKF_VERIFY for mechanisms that support verify. Applications that query GetMechanismInfo before calling C_VerifyInit will fail or skip verify entirely.
